turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, I'm reaching out about your past-due account.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Stop contacting me. I'm not paying anything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've noted your request to stop contact.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What could you pay, and when?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can pay 180 on 11/20.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $180.00 on November 20.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your past-due amount is $500.00. Can you make a payment soon?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll pay two fifty in two weeks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: OK I'll pay $200 Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $200 this Friday.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Actually no, I need to talk to my wife first. Don't put me down for anything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood, nothing is scheduled.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our records show $640.00 past due on this account.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I don't owe this. This isn't my loan and I want it investigated.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll pass this to our disputes team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to schedule a payment?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Sure. I'll pay $45.50 on Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $45.50 on Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your minimum payment is $120.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I can only do 80 dollars, on the 20th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've recorded $80 on November 20.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your balance is $1,500.00.

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I want to clear it. 1.5k on December 1st.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, the full balance on December 1.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you make a payment toward the $300.00 past due?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I'll try to pay something next month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Contact us when you're ready.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything you can pay today?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: Yeah, I'll send fifty bucks today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When is your next payday?

turns.speaker: borrower
turns.text: I get paid on the first. I'll pay $300 then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, $300 on the first.
